summary: The actual feature work is sound: the approval-flow schema addition (draft/submitted/approved/rejected enum + approvedById/approvedAt/rejectionReason on pms_time_entries), the hand-written additive migration, the submit/approve/reject service functions (tenant-scoped, self-approval blocked, state machine enforced), the manager-role-gated routes, and the two new designer-wise reports are all correctly implemented, properly tested (29 new/touched tests pass locally, full suite 2244/0 matching the PROGRESS.md claim, tsc clean, no .github/workflows/** touched), and follow this repo's established conventions closely. However, the self-report is not trustworthy as submitted: re-running the repo's own CI gates locally and checking the real PR on GitHub shows 'Terminology Guardrail Check' actually FAILS (exit 1) -- this PR introduces 5 new hardcoded-ISO-date findings (the '2026-07-28' dates in its own new comments across schema.ts, pms-time-service.ts, and 3 new *.test.ts files) but never adds the corresponding entries to ai-os/registry/terminology-guardrail-exemptions.yaml, unlike every prior task in this same PROGRESS.md's history which did so as a matter of course. `gh pr checks 613` confirms this is live-red on GitHub right now, not just a local artifact. A second check, 'Metadata Index Coverage Check', is also red on the live PR but is pre-existing (caused by an unrelated, unindexed ai-os/audits/ file from a prior task, not touched by this diff) so it is not this PR's fault, just noted for context. Given real CI is failing and PROGRESS.md's verification claims ('all pass') are inaccurate for at least one gate this PR itself caused, this is not ready to hand to a human for merge yet -- it needs a small, mechanical fix (register the 5 new dated-comment exemptions) before re-review.
issues: CI-blocking: 'Terminology Guardrail Check' fails (confirmed both by local `node scripts/check-terminology-guardrail.mjs --diff-only` exit 1, and live via `gh pr checks 613`) -- 5 new unexempted hardcoded-ISO-date findings introduced by this PR's own new comments (schema.ts:4206, pms-time-service.ts:66, and the 3 new *.test.ts files) were never added to ai-os/registry/terminology-guardrail-exemptions.yaml, breaking this repo's own established per-task convention.
